variant.author: Snowy, KangasZ
variant.description:
A tool to assist you on your Eureka adventures, now updated for Dawntrail! Type /eurekahelper to get started.

Features include:
- In-Game Tracker GUI
- Instance Tracker
- Elementals Tracker
- Relic Helper
- Alarms
- Money NM weather timings
- More to come
variant.name: Eureka Helper
variant.punchline: Eureka Tracker in a plugin with many other features.
